explication: Apache Spark is a unified engine for large-scale analytics, exposed through Scala, Java, Python, and deprecated R APIs. Users submit computations through those APIs; Spark executes general computation graphs and returns results through its higher-level tools, including SQL/DataFrames, MLlib, GraphX, and Structured Streaming. The tree also shows shuffle transport and newer pipeline support as internal or product subsystems. Source excerpts are limited, so edges between major capabilities rely on the README; the shuffle-manager relationships are supported by its excerpt.
